summary.one_liner: A Claude Code plugin that runs an autonomous AI copywriter for SaaS content marketing, using the Ralph Wiggum iterative loop over a SQLite content database.
summary.what_it_does: The plugin adds slash commands (/ralph-init, /ralph-marketer, /ralph-status, /ralph-cancel) to Claude Code for setting up and running a content project. Input tables for trends, research, and product communications are described as coming from other agents (TrendScout, Research, Product/Marketing), and a copywriter agent reads them to plan, draft, review, and publish content. Work is tracked through a prd.json task list with pass/fail stories, a progress.txt learnings log, and git commits, with each loop iteration starting in a fresh context. The default task list has 12 stories covering blogs, a case study, social posts, a newsletter, and metrics logging. Customization happens by editing a seed script for inputs and adding tasks to prd.json.
use_cases: Automating SaaS blog and case study drafting
Generating social posts and newsletters from product updates
Running an iterative AI writing loop overnight
Turning market research notes into content plans
Experimenting with the Ralph loop pattern in Claude Code
notable: Ralph loop: picks the highest-priority story with passes:false, executes, verifies, commits, and repeats
Memory persists only through git history, progress.txt, and prd.json between fresh context windows
Multi-agent design where TrendScout, Research, and Product/Marketing feed a shared SQLite database
Installable as a Claude Code marketplace plugin or loaded locally with --plugin-dir
caveats: The README does not describe how the input agents (TrendScout, Research) are implemented; the seed script populates sample data
Output quality depends on the task criteria and the loop's tests, which the README does not detail
Requires Claude Code; the README does not state other platform requirements
